one_liner: Air Force direct-hire pool for violence prevention staff at bases and headquarters: running training, programs, and evaluation aimed at harassment, assault, suicide, and other harm.
fit_summary: Daniel's people skills, policy knowledge, and government-client consulting at IEM fit the outreach, coordination, and compliance side of this work. However, every grade asks for experience specifically in violence prevention or in behavioral, social science, or public health practice, and that is not on file. The 0101 basic requirement also hinges on a social or behavioral science degree, coursework, or equivalent experience, which Daniel must verify.
eligibility: Open to the public (U.S. citizens); no federal status or veterans' preference needed, and no clearance required.

Basic 0101 requirement: a degree in behavioral or social science or a related field, or a qualifying combination of education and experience (both require transcripts), or 4 years of experience equivalent to a major. Check whether your degree (e.g., political science) qualifies.

GS-9 requires 1 year of specialized experience at GS-7 level (violence prevention, behavioral/social science or public health duties) or 2 years of graduate education. GS-11 and up require progressively more prevention and training-design experience.
Transcripts must be uploaded with the application if education is used to qualify.
Duty location is an Air or Space Force installation (Multiple Locations) with no telework, so confirm which sites are actually hiring.
keywords: behavioral, social science and/or public health
communicate effectively, both orally and in writing
strategy: Apply at GS-9 (possibly GS-11 if your IEM role was senior). Use public-health language to frame IEM work as preparedness, community resilience, and risk assessment: identifying community risk and protective factors, then planning programs for them.
Emphasize any training, exercise design, workshop facilitation, or stakeholder coordination at IEM, since training design and coordination with installation partners map directly to KSAs 3 and 4.

Name your degree and any social science, psychology, sociology, or public health coursework, and upload transcripts. If the degree is political science, attach transcripts anyway and argue the related-discipline route.
Keep the resume to two pages. For each role, list start/end month and year, hours per week, and one or two bullets that mirror the specialized experience wording.
Answer the questionnaire honestly at the level your resume proves; inflated answers the resume doesn't support lead to a 'not qualified' rating.
The announcement stays open until 2026-12-18 and referrals may be pulled periodically, so apply early and reapply or update if your resume changes.
resume_bullets: Supported [government client] preparedness program by assessing community risk factors and vulnerable populations across [scope], informing [plan/initiative] in line with [FEMA/state guidance].
Designed and facilitated [number] trainings/exercises for [audience, size] on [topic], and evaluated effectiveness through [after-action reports/surveys].
Coordinated with [number] federal, state, and local stakeholders to keep [program] in compliance with [regulations/policies], and briefed [leadership level] orally and in writing.
interview_questions: Tell us about a time you designed or delivered training to a group and how you measured whether it worked.
How would you identify risk and protective factors for a base population and choose prevention activities?
Describe working with multiple organizations, like a Community Action Team, to carry out a shared initiative.
How do you make sure a program is implemented as designed and complies with policy?
watch_outs: Experience specific to violence prevention or public health is the core qualifier, and it is not in your known background, so you may be rated not qualified without it.
Degree/0101 basic requirement: a non-social-science degree with no qualifying coursework could disqualify you.
Duty is on an installation in 'Multiple Locations' with no telework, so relocation or a long commute from Manassas may be required.
This is a broad standing pool (direct hire authority covering many titles), so hearing back can be slow or uneven; keep applying to other jobs in parallel.
